WITH OrderInvoiceCounts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
), Shares AS (
    SELECT order_id, invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share
    FROM OrderInvoiceCounts
), AverageShare AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share
    FROM Shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(s.invoice_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.invoice_share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM Shares s
CROSS JOIN AverageShare a
WHERE s.invoice_share > a.average_share
